title: Saudian Dumpling Delight
description: A flavorful dish from Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring dumplings in a rich cheese sauce. Quick and easy to make.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a dumpling.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In a separate saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded cheese and stir until melted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
